---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Gabriella Buccellato"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse) 
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```



```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

con_seda <- dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  "data/seda_2025.duckdb",
  read_only = TRUE
)

dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con_seda, "district_scores")
dbplyr_state <- tbl(con_seda, "state_scores")

```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  group_by(district_id) |>
  summarise(
    score_2015 = max(if_else(year == 2015, rla_score, NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
    score_2023 = max(if_else(year == 2023, rla_score, NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(score_2015), !is.na(score_2023)) |>
  mutate(change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  collect()

dbplyr_state <- tbl(con_seda, "state_scores")

state_change <- dbplyr_state |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  group_by(stateabb) |>
  summarise(
    score_2015 = max(if_else(year == 2015, rla_score, NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
    score_2023 = max(if_else(year == 2023, rla_score, NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(score_2015), !is.na(score_2023)) |>
  mutate(change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| message: false

ggplot(score_change, aes(x = change, fill = change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "forestgreen", "FALSE" = "tomato"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    x = "Change in RLA score (2023 - 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate declines."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 9
#| out-width: 85%

plot_data <- state_change |>
  arrange(score_2023) |>
  mutate(stateabb = factor(stateabb, levels = stateabb))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = stateabb)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = score_2015,
      xend = score_2023,
      yend = stateabb,
      color = change > 0
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = grid::unit(2, "mm")),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = score_2015),
    color = "gray60",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "forestgreen", "FALSE" = "tomato"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) as.character(x),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015–2023",
    subtitle = "States ordered by their 2023 reading scores",
    x = "RLA score",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point toward 2023. Green indicates increases; red indicates no increase."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0)
  )

```
